http_status.title: Page answers 200
http_status.why: A page that redirects or errors cannot rank and wastes crawl budget.
http_status.fix: Fix the URL, or put the final URL in the sitemap and links.

canonical.title: Canonical points to the page itself
canonical.why: A wrong canonical tells search engines to index a different URL.
canonical.fix: Set a self-referencing canonical in the SEO plugin.

indexable.title: Page can be indexed (no noindex)
indexable.why: A noindex page drops out of search and AI answers.
indexable.fix: Remove noindex in the page's SEO settings.

html_lang.title: Page language is declared
html_lang.why: Search engines and AI use it to pick the language of the answer.
html_lang.fix: Set the lang attribute of <html> in the theme.

viewport.title: Mobile viewport is set
viewport.why: Without it the page is treated as not mobile-friendly.
viewport.fix: Add the viewport meta tag to the theme.

sitemap_hygiene.title: Sitemap lists only clean pages
sitemap_hygiene.why: A sitemap should list pages that answer 200, are indexable and are their own canonical.
sitemap_hygiene.fix: Remove the URL from the sitemap or fix the page it points to.

title_length.title: Title is 30 to 60 characters
title_length.why: Longer titles are cut in search results; very short ones say too little.
title_length.fix: Rewrite the title. For a templated section (glossary, hire) change the title pattern once.

meta_present.title: Meta description is present
meta_present.why: Search engines show their own random excerpt when it is missing.
meta_present.fix: Write a meta description in the page's SEO settings.

meta_length.title: Meta description is 120 to 158 characters
meta_length.why: Outside this range it is cut or looks thin in results.
meta_length.fix: Rewrite the meta description. For a templated section change the pattern once.

h1_count.title: Exactly one H1
h1_count.why: The H1 tells search engines and AI what the page is about.
h1_count.fix: Make the main heading the only H1.

title_h1_match.title: Title and H1 say the same thing
title_h1_match.why: A title and H1 about different things confuse search engines.
title_h1_match.fix: Align the title and the H1.

heading_order.title: No heading level is skipped
heading_order.why: Skipped levels (H2 to H4) blur the page outline for search engines and screen readers.
heading_order.fix: Fix the heading levels in the content.

thin_content.title: Page has enough text
thin_content.why: Very short pages rarely rank and give AI little to quote.
thin_content.fix: Add real content, or merge or remove the page.

og_present.title: Open Graph tags are present
og_present.why: They control the title, text and image of a shared link.
og_present.fix: Set og:title, og:description and og:image in the SEO plugin.

og_url_canonical.title: og:url equals the canonical
og_url_canonical.why: A different og:url splits shares between two URLs.
og_url_canonical.fix: Fix og:url in the SEO plugin.

twitter_card.title: twitter:card is present
twitter_card.why: Without it shared links on X look plain.
twitter_card.fix: Set twitter:card in the SEO plugin.

duplicate_title.title: Titles are unique
duplicate_title.why: The same title on several pages makes them compete with each other.
duplicate_title.fix: Give each page its own title.

duplicate_meta.title: Meta descriptions are unique
duplicate_meta.why: The same description on several pages makes them look alike in results.
duplicate_meta.fix: Give each page its own description.

duplicate_h1.title: H1 headings are unique
duplicate_h1.why: The same H1 on several pages makes them compete with each other.
duplicate_h1.fix: Give each page its own H1.

jsonld_valid.title: JSON-LD parses
jsonld_valid.why: Broken JSON-LD is ignored by search engines.
jsonld_valid.fix: Fix the markup in the theme or the SEO plugin.

schema_required.title: Required structured data is present
schema_required.why: The page type needs this markup (for example Article or Service) to be understood and shown properly.
schema_required.fix: Add the missing type in the SEO plugin or the theme.

schema_recommended.title: Recommended structured data is present
schema_recommended.why: Markup such as BreadcrumbList helps search engines show the page's place on the site.
schema_recommended.fix: Turn it on in the SEO plugin; usually one change for the whole page type.

article_fields.title: Article markup has all its fields
article_fields.why: Headline, dates, author, image and publisher are what Article results need.
article_fields.fix: Fill the missing fields in the page or the SEO plugin.

author.title: Author is named
author.why: A named author is a trust signal for search engines and AI answers.

dates.title: Publication and modified dates are in the markup
dates.why: Fresh, dated content is preferred by search engines and AI answers.
dates.fix: Make the template output datePublished and dateModified.

date_mismatch.title: Visible date matches dateModified
date_mismatch.why: A visible date that differs from the markup looks careless and can mislead.
date_mismatch.fix: Make the visible date and dateModified come from the same field.

faq_schema_matches_dom.title: FAQ markup matches the page
faq_schema_matches_dom.why: FAQ markup without a visible FAQ (or the reverse) is ignored or penalised.
faq_schema_matches_dom.fix: Show the FAQ on the page, or remove the FAQPage markup.

broken_internal_links.title: Internal links work
broken_internal_links.why: Broken links waste crawl budget and frustrate visitors.

redirecting_internal_links.title: Internal links go straight to the page
redirecting_internal_links.why: A link through a redirect is slower and loses a little ranking signal.

link_to_services.title: Page links to a service page
link_to_services.why: Content pages should lead readers and search engines to what the company sells.
link_to_services.fix: Add a link to the most relevant /services/ page.

anchors_resolve.title: Anchor links have a target
anchors_resolve.why: A #link with no matching id does nothing.
anchors_resolve.fix: Fix the anchor or the id.

orphan_page.title: Every page is linked from another page
orphan_page.why: A page nothing links to is hard for search engines to find and looks unimportant.
orphan_page.fix: Link to it from a relevant page or a listing, or remove it if obsolete.

alt_missing.title: Images have an alt attribute
alt_missing.why: Alt text is how search engines and screen readers understand an image.

alt_empty.title: Images have non-empty alt text
alt_empty.why: An empty alt tells search engines the image is decoration.
alt_empty.fix: Describe meaningful images; leave it empty only for decoration.

image_dimensions.title: Images have width and height
image_dimensions.why: Without sizes the page jumps while loading (a layout shift).
image_dimensions.fix: Output width and height attributes in the theme.

robots_ai_bots.title: robots.txt lets AI bots in
robots_ai_bots.why: A blocked bot cannot read the site and cannot cite it.
robots_ai_bots.fix: Remove the Disallow rule for the bot in robots.txt.

llms_txt.title: llms.txt is present
llms_txt.why: A file that tells AI assistants what the site is and which pages matter.

robots_txt.title: robots.txt is served and names the sitemap
robots_txt.why: Crawlers read robots.txt first; a missing file or sitemap line slows discovery.
robots_txt.fix: Serve /robots.txt as plain text and add a Sitemap: line.

robots_crawlers.title: Search crawlers can reach every section
robots_crawlers.why: A Disallow rule on a section hides it from search.
robots_crawlers.fix: Remove or narrow the Disallow rule in robots.txt.

site_https.title: http and www redirect to the one HTTPS address
site_https.why: Several addresses for one site split links and rankings between them.
site_https.fix: Redirect http and the other host to https://gogloby.com/ with one permanent (301) redirect.

soft_404.title: Missing pages answer 404
soft_404.why: A 200 on a missing page (a soft 404) fills the index with empty pages.
soft_404.fix: Make the theme send a 404 status on the not-found page.

sitemap_lastmod.title: Sitemap files carry lastmod
sitemap_lastmod.why: Search engines use lastmod to decide what to recrawl.
sitemap_lastmod.fix: Turn lastmod on in the sitemap plugin.

sitemap_urls_clean.title: Sitemap lists each URL once, on the main host over HTTPS
sitemap_urls_clean.why: Repeated, http or foreign-host entries make the sitemap untrustworthy.
sitemap_urls_clean.fix: Remove the entries from the sitemap source.

llms_txt_format.title: llms.txt is a real text file that names pages
llms_txt_format.why: An HTML error page or an empty file gives an AI assistant nothing to follow.
llms_txt_format.fix: Publish llms.txt as plain text with links to the key pages.

llms_txt_links.title: Links in llms.txt work
llms_txt_links.why: A broken link in llms.txt sends AI assistants to an error.

llms_full_txt.title: llms-full.txt is present (optional)
llms_full_txt.why: A single file with the full text of the key pages is easy for AI assistants to read.

content_stale.title: Content is kept up to date
content_stale.why: AI answers and search results prefer pages that are kept up to date.
content_stale.fix: Review the page and update it, then change its modified date.

home_title_exact.title: Home title is the approved one
home_title_exact.why: The home title is the first thing search results and AI answers say about the company.
home_title_exact.fix: Set the approved title in the SEO plugin.

trap_terms.title: No trap term in title, H1, meta or og
trap_terms.why: These terms position the company wrongly (Glossary §8).
trap_terms.fix: Rewrite the title, H1 or description without the term.

nearshore_not_first.title: No nearshore or LatAm in the hero
nearshore_not_first.why: The hero must not lead with nearshore wording (Glossary §9).

faq_present.title: Home and service pages have an FAQ
faq_present.why: FAQ answers are what AI assistants quote most.

em_dash.title: No em dash
em_dash.fix: Replace the dash with a comma, a colon or a new sentence.

ampersand.title: "and" instead of "&"
ampersand.why: House style (Glossary §9); "Data & AI" and brand names are allowed.
ampersand.fix: Write "and", or add the name to the allow-list in GEO settings.

blocks.snapshot: A snapshot is a photo of the whole site: the app opened every page once and saved what it found. Everything on this page is worked out from that photo, so reading it is free and quick. If the site has changed since, make a new snapshot. Page runs on the Run page compare each page with the latest snapshot.
blocks.summary: How many technical checks the site fails, and how serious they are. High: the page cannot rank or be shared properly. Medium: it hurts results, fix soon. Low: small hygiene. SEO is about search engines, GEO is about AI assistants and positioning. Writing style is counted apart, so many small findings do not hide the important ones.
blocks.fix_first: The most serious problems, the ones that touch more pages first. Start here.
blocks.all_checks: One line is one check. "143 of 690" means the check applies to 690 pages and 143 of them fail it. Red dot: serious, amber: medium, grey: small, green: all good. Open a line to see why it matters, how to fix it and which pages fail. The arrows show what changed since the previous snapshot: green is fixed, red is new.
blocks.template_text: Banners, forms and site-wide markup repeat on hundreds of pages, so they are checked once, not page by page. The model compares their text with the company documents. Each problem is listed once with every banner, form or markup node where it appears. One fix in the template changes all those pages.
blocks.coverage: What the check covered: how many addresses the sitemap lists, how many were opened, and which sections they belong to. Pages outside the scope are not audited.
